items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: he was talking about Von Hangman

ctx.x: So -- but shit, man, they passed with flying colors, man. So Prez went down there talking his hep talk, "Well, voodaroony," says, "I see you all got Von Hangman eyes. So I'm going to have to play my role." So they tell me Jo Jones said they asked, "What is this guy? Has this guy got German in him?" You know, he was talking about Von Hangman --
